limitations: Previously exposed authored development corpus; original validation preserved, not a fresh holdout.
8D linguistic hashes, 384D GTE-small and 768D GTE-multilingual differ in representation, source producer and parameter count. This does not isolate dimensionality.
Inherited source-agnostic decoder tensors transfer; native conditioning is reset, so these are new formula sidecars and not previous checkpoint continuations.
The frozen identity projection and its near-zero MSE are not learned feature reconstruction or semantic qualification.
Clause context uses literal blank-line segmentation and exact verified cache lookup; it is not a general federal-span parser.
Structural clause permutation equivariance is not learned order recovery; scalar scores and whole-document exactness are distinct.
No global optimum, logic-family qualification, Lake build, production promotion or Constitution formalization is established.
outcome: Twelve fits of formula sidecars with native input dimensions completed under the fixed budget with unchanged full-generation selection and corruption controls. Source producers differ across dimensions; the identity projection is fixed by construction; inverse-normalized input MSE may contain floating-point roundoff and is not learned reconstruction. No trained checkpoint passed selection; all twelve retained epoch 0.
reproducibility_scope: Artifact closure and original-path mapping; installed libraries, hardware and large local encoder assets are external. Preparation executes72native768source encodes; training uses cached source vectors.

resources.child_time_scope: includes monitoring and accounting before reap; excludes initial admission

source_preparation_resources.child_time_scope: includes monitoring and accounting before reap; excludes initial admission

telemetry.workload: Private formula decoder training on cached inputs: 12 fits with identical 340-update exposure; the clause head has 512 fewer trainable parameters within each dimension. No order augmentation or boundary auxiliary loss.

test_scope: The full 57-file attempt has 16 setup errors in the retained, unused Legal v2 package fixture. The scoped rerun retains the actual historical 8D source producer test and every other file. Both raw test attempts are preserved.
